product_metadata.title: MAYTEX Pixel Ultra Soft Stretch 2 Piece Furniture Cover Loveseat Slipcover, Sand
features: TRANSFORM THE LOOK OF YOUR LOVESEAT FOR LESS: A new Pixel slipcover instantly refreshes your room décor and saves you from the expense of new furniture; ideal for updating and protecting your furniture for work from home needs
EASY INSTALLATION: Durable yet comfortable slipcover is easy to install, with instructional tags to seamlessly guide you through the installation process
PATENTED SEPARATE SEAT CUSHION: Features a patented 2-piece separate seat cushion for a semi-custom look; compatible with box cushions and t-cushions
SUPERIOR DESIGN AND FIT: Soft, lightweight, stretchable fabric with a textured mini-dot design contours to the shape of your furniture, and built-in elastic corners keep your slipcover in place

FITS STANDARD-SHAPE LOVESEATS: Pixel fits standard-shape loveseats up to 73 inches long (Please check out our size guides on this page before purchasing to get the best fit. For leather furniture, we recommend using a non-slip underlay to achieve a better fit)
EXTEND THE LIFE OF YOUR FURNITURE: Protects your loveseat from all that sitting around that you’ve been doing!
MACHINE WASHABLE: Easy to keep your loveseat clean and looking like new
STANDARD 100 by OEKO-TEX certification keeps you and your family safe from harmful substances [20.HUS.23766 HOHENSTEIN HTTI]
description: You'll feel great about choosing the Maytex Pixel 2-Piece Fabric Slipcover when you see how it instantly transforms the look of your favorite loveseat. You’ll feel even better knowing that you've saved money by extending your loveseat's life instead of buying new furniture and disposing of the old one in a landfill. The decorative textured mini-dot design on the Pixel slipcover's ultra-soft stretch fabric will refresh your room while the cover protects your loveseat from food, drinks and pets. Built-in elastic corners ensure that the cover stays in place. The Pixel furniture cover fits standard-shape loveseats measuring up to 73 inches long. The machine-washable Pixel furniture protector is available in a variety of sizes and colors to coordinate with your room decor. Installation is easy, with instructional tags to guide you.
